name: switchback
description: Local-first coding agent that escalates to a hosted model (OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, ...) only when it needs to.

switchback.executablePath.description: Path to the switchback executable. Empty: the switchback CLI when it's at least as new as the engine bundled with the extension, else the bundled engine. The extension runs `<path> serve --stdio`.

switchback.executableArgs.description: Arguments inserted before `serve --stdio` (e.g. a script path when executablePath is `bun`).

switchback.defaultRoute.description: Routing for new prompts. `auto` follows your switchback config.

switchback.reviewEditsInDiffEditor.description: Open proposed edits in the diff editor with Accept / Reject buttons, in addition to the prompt in the chat.

switchback.sharedEngine.description: Attach to the workspace's shared Switchback engine, so the terminal UI and VS Code see the same live sessions. Off: this window runs its own engine.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Switchback
walkthroughs.description: A local-first coding agent that escalates to a hosted model only when a turn needs it.

steps.title: Open the chat
steps.description:
Switchback lives in its own view in the activity bar.
[Open Chat](command:switchback.chat.focus)

media.altText: The Switchback chat: a prompt, the local model that answered and its speed, tool calls, and the answer

steps.title: Choose your models
steps.description:
Pick where turns start and what they escalate to: local, hosted, or both.
[Set Up Models](command:switchback.runSetup)

steps.title: Ask something
steps.description:
Type a question or a task and press Enter. Each answer shows which model ran it, why, and how fast. Mention files with @, run commands with /, and paste images.
[Open Chat](command:switchback.chat.focus)

media.altText: The Switchback chat: a prompt, the local model that answered and its speed, tool calls, and the answer

steps.title: Decide where turns run
steps.description:
Auto starts locally and escalates when the model is stuck, asking first when it costs money. Local and Remote pin the next prompts to one side.
[Choose a Route](command:switchback.setRoute)

media.altText: An escalation prompt asking whether to move a turn to a hosted model, with the reason and estimated cost

steps.title: Review edits before they land
steps.description: Edits open in the diff editor with Accept and Reject; Always this session or Always in this project remembers your answer for similar calls.

media.altText: A permission prompt showing the diff of a proposed edit, with Allow and Deny buttons

steps.title: Use the terminal too
steps.description:
The `switchback` terminal UI runs the same engine and shares live sessions with this window.
[Install Terminal Command](command:switchback.installCli)

scripts.build: bun build src/extension.ts --target=node --format=cjs --external vscode --outfile dist/extension.js && bun build src/webview/main.ts --target=browser --outfile dist/webview.js
scripts.package: bun run build && cp ../../CHANGELOG.md CHANGELOG.md && vsce package --no-dependencies --baseContentUrl https://github.com/Harville-Labs/switchback/blob/main --baseImagesUrl https://github.com/Harville-Labs/switchback/raw/main
scripts.build:test: bun build test/suite/*.itest.ts --outdir out/test --target node --format cjs --external vscode
scripts.test: bun run build && bun run build:test && vscode-test --label dev
scripts.test:bundled: bun run build && bun run build:test && bun ../cli/scripts/build.ts --outfile bin/switchback && vscode-test --label bundled
